summary: doc-manager container crash-looped on VPS staging with RuntimeError: Form data requires "python-multipart" to be installed; service unavailable until image rebuilt.
root_cause: doc-manager/requirements.txt omitted python-multipart although FastAPI File/Form endpoints require it. The dependency was declared only in platform/backend requirements.
recovery: Appended python-multipart==0.0.12 to doc-manager/requirements.txt locally and on /opt/chatbot/doc-manager, rebuilt image, restarted. /docs/health returned 200.
prevention: Smoke-test every FastAPI service container startup in staging before declaring a build complete; add requirements parity check across services.
